entities.summary: Djamili-Dini Aboudou Moindze is a French boxer of Comorian descent who won a bronze medal at the 2024 Summer Olympics. He competed at the men's +92 kg weight division and reached the semifinals after defeating Mourad Kadi and Gerlon Congo.
